title: Zy Poutine Fritters with Canadian Cheese
description: A crispy fritter filled with poutine, topped with melted Canadian cheese, inspired by Italian cuisine.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine flour, dark chocolate chips, and zy.
2. Add poutine to the bowl and mix well.
3. Divide the mixture into 8 equal parts.
4. Shape each part into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk.
5. Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium heat.
6. Add the fritters to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
7. Sprinkle Canadian cheese on top of each fritter and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.
